$comment: Drop this at your project root. Claude Code auto-detects it. Extracted from ADLTrack (frontend/src/context/ThemeContext.jsx + App.css) on 2026-08-18.
name: adltrack-airbnb-inspired

design_system.philosophy: Airbnb warmth on iOS bones. Calm neutral canvas, one hot coral accent used sparingly, generous radii, hairline borders instead of heavy shadows, and system-native status colors. Clarity over density. Every surface should feel touchable and trustworthy on a phone first.

rules: Inputs are ALWAYS >= 16px font-size to stop iOS Safari zoom-on-focus.

brand_and_status.$comment: Identical in both themes so status reads the same everywhere.

colors.tinting_rule: Never fill a surface with a saturated brand color. Tint it: `${COLOR}14` (8% alpha) for icon tiles, `${COLOR}12` for badges, `rgba(r,g,b,0.10)` for soft chips, `${COLOR}40` for the colored glow under a primary button.

shapes.rule: Radius scales with the element. Small controls 8-12, cards 14-16, hero CTAs 20, anything pill-shaped 999.

elevation.rule: Structure comes from 1px hairline borders, not shadow. Shadows are a whisper — never a drop shadow you can point at. In dark mode drop shadows entirely and let the border carry it.

patterns.stagger: List children fade+rise 12px, 50ms apart, capped at 10 items

motion.rule: All motion must be wrapped by prefers-reduced-motion:reduce.

interaction.touch_target: 44x44px minimum below 768px — enforced globally on button
interaction.focus_ring: 2px solid #FF385C, offset 2px, radius 6 (cards: offset 3, radius 16), :focus-visible only
interaction.safe_area: padding-bottom: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) on any bottom-fixed bar

component_recipes.card: background:CARD; border:1px solid BORDER; border-radius:14; padding:16; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)
component_recipes.icon_tile: width:44; height:44; border-radius:12; background:`${color}14`; flex-center; flex-shrink:0
component_recipes.primary_button: background:PRIMARY; color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:12; padding:13px 0; font-weight:700; box-shadow:0 8px 24px ${PRIMARY}40
component_recipes.secondary_button: background:CARD2; border:1px solid BORDER; border-radius:12; color:TEXT; font-weight:600
component_recipes.disabled_button: background:CARD2; border:1px solid BORDER; color:MUTED; cursor:not-allowed; box-shadow:none
component_recipes.input: width:100%; padding:14px 16px; background:CARD2; border-radius:12; color:TEXT; outline:none; font-size:16
component_recipes.status_pill: display:inline-flex; gap:6; background:rgba(52,199,89,0.10); border:1px solid rgba(52,199,89,0.20); border-radius:999; padding:6px 14px + 7px dot with 2px glow ring
component_recipes.micro_badge: font-size:10; font-weight:800; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.06em; border-radius:6; padding:2px 7px; tinted bg
component_recipes.stat_tile: background:CARD; border:1px solid BORDER; border-radius:16; padding:16px 12px; text-align:center; 36px icon tile centered above
component_recipes.avatar_ring: 108px circle, padding:3, background:linear-gradient(135deg,PRIMARY,WARNING), inner circle with 3px solid CARD border, 20px status dot bottom-right

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui (new-york, neutral base, CSS variables) + inline style objects driven by useTheme()
stack.animation: framer-motion for layout/presence, CSS keyframes for entrance

hard_rules: Mobile-first. Design the 375px view, then widen.
One accent color. #FF385C carries primary actions and focus only — it never becomes a background wash.
Every interactive element has a visible :focus-visible ring.
Both themes ship together — never add a color that only works in light mode.
Preserve data-testid attributes when editing existing components.
